actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes two attacks: one with its [[/item .JwAFMjU7vHDDL2Ib]]{beak} and one with its [[/item .H5JJE8uS39dTI3Vg]]{talons}.

actions.name: spores
actions.desc: A [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=6NlNH6h0uxCCjmPL]] cloud of toxic spores extends out from the vrock. The spores spread around corners. Each creature in that area must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or become &Reference[poisoned]. While poisoned in this way, a target takes [[/damage average]] damage at the start of each of its turns. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Emptying a vial of @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.nshr9PBVyB03T7wB]{Holy Water} on the target also ends the effect on it.

actions.name: stunning screech
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} emits a horrific screech. Each creature within 20 feet of it that can hear it and that isn't a demon must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or be &reference[stunned] until the end of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn .

actions.name: magic resistance
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
